summary: Reproduced that VisionFlash4Attention dropped window_size and s_aux at the external flash_attn_func boundary, then forwarded window_size, optional s_aux as sinks, and ver=4. Added CPU regression coverage for defaults, window-only, sink-only, combined arguments, and the actual VisionAttention-to-VisionFlash4Attention path. The combined path is checked against an independent explicit local-mask and attention-sink tensor reference.

tests.what_was_measured: Recorded-base source behavior before the implementation change: 5/5 regressions failed. Four boundary cases had no window_size key, and the full VisionAttention path disagreed with the independent local-window/sink reference. Raw JUnit output is baseline.xml.gz.

12 tests passed: FA4 boundary forwarding for default, window-only, sink-only, and combined cases; ver=4; actual VisionAttention routing; independent reference equality; and existing precomputed max-seqlen behavior. Raw JUnit output is fixed.xml.gz.
24 adjacent VisionAttention backend-selection and QKV-layout tests passed.
Formatting/lint tool availability only: the prepared interpreter does not contain the ruff module. git diff --check passed separately.

gpu_execution_evidence: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 exposed exactly one AMD Instinct MI355X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015. VisionFlash4Attention is CUDA-only and its FA4 CUTE kernel requires NVIDIA architecture, so the instrumented boundary tests are CPU tests and are not claimed as GPU kernel execution.
remaining_limitations: The CUDA-only FA4 kernel was not executed or numerically qualified on this ROCm host.
No NVIDIA Blackwell GPU or MiMo-V2.5 multimodal model weights were available, so end-to-end model output remains unverified here.

The independent numerical reference verifies the intended equal-length non-causal local-window and learned-sink semantics at the instrumented external boundary; it is not a substitute for CUDA kernel qualification.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The prepared Python environment lacks ruff; git diff --check passed and pytest coverage passed.
